sentences.text: R1 & R5 appeared through counsel, but counter  have not been filed.
R2 & R3 being minors are represented by  Respondent No.1.
Notice sent to R4/co-claimant was returned unserved, though it was sent to the same address as given before the tribunal.
Hence, it is treated as proper service.

Though notice sent to R6 to the address as given before the tribunal, it was returned unserved with an endorsement 'insufficient address".
R6/R1 remained ex parte before the tribunal.
Hence, no further notice is ordered.
Contd...
For the reasons stated in the accompanying affidavit, the petition is allowed.
__ B.S. BHANUMATHI, J Admit.
Registry is directed to call for the lower Court records.
Post after two (02) months.

sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the petitioner/appellant submitted that the claim was raised under Section163- A of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (in short 'Act') and therefore the claim cannot be adjudicated under Section 166 of the Act and therefore the amount of compensation awarded not by following the structured formula is illegal.
Perusal of the record shows that in the copy of Contd...
the insurance Rs.180/- was deducted towards the premium for paid driver.

Anyhow, since it is matter of adjudication in the appeal, interim stay as prayed for is granted on the condition that the appellant shall deposit 50% of the amount of compensation as per the decree within eight (08) weeks from the date of this Order, failing which, the interim stay granted gets vacated without any further orders.
__________________ B.S.BHANUMATHI,J DSV
